reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis conflates bulk alloying with a surface intervention, and the proposed mechanism (solid-solution strengthening) does not clearly explain how a surface oxide layer improves mechanical properties; the link between lattice distortion and surface characteristics is vague.
reasons.testability: The test is described generically (comparative study, measure wear/corrosion/mechanical properties) but lacks specifics on how the 'high-entropy alloying' is applied as a surface treatment, making it unclear what exactly would be tested.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is too broad and does not specify a concrete surface engineering intervention, so it offers little actionable guidance for a researcher working on surface modification of existing components.
